title: If the Move To term was deactivated meanwhile, the move is refused
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have a second user, user B, signed in with the "Admin" role in a second browser (you are signed in as an Admin in the first).
  • Make sure COD is the shop's default for new customers.
  • Create a new term of the shop's own for this test, term A, due 20 days after the invoice date.
  • Create customer A for this test on term A.
  • Make sure Net 45 is active.
  • Start with the Credit Terms page open in both browsers.
custom_steps:
1. Click the "⋯" at the right of the term A row.
  2. Click "Move Customers".
  3. Choose "Net 45" in "Move To".
  4. In user B's browser, click the "⋯" at the right of the "Net 45" row.
  5. In user B's browser, click "Deactivate".
  6. In your browser, click "Move 1 Customer".
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The menu opens.

Step 2:

  • A window titled "Move Customers from term A" opens.

Step 3:

  • The dropdown shows Net 45.

Step 4:

  • User B's menu opens.

Step 5:

  • User B sees "Net 45 deactivated".

Step 6:

  • The app's error alert shows "Pick an active term other than term A." and the window stays open.
  • Customer A is still on term A.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11673 (Story 4, Move Customers)

  • Story 4, Error Handling: “If the chosen "Move To" term was deactivated or deleted meanwhile, the move is refused with "Pick an active term other than {from term}." The window stays open.”
  • User Feedback Summary: “Move To term no longer active (server) | "Pick an active term other than {from term}." | Standard error alert, window stays open”
